log: |rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon
|-damage|p2a: Incineroar|87/100|[from] ability: Rough Skin|[of] p1a: Garchomp

decisions.thought: Opponent has Primarina and Incineroar threatening Kingambit and Garchomp. Gholdengo blocks status and pressures Primarina, Garchomp leads well vs Incineroar/Dragonite, and Sylveon covers Dragonite/Garchomp. This core covers their team best.
Incineroar lead gives Fake Out and Intimidate safety into unknown leads, Primarina covers Garchomp and Kingambit, Mega Garchomp gives speed and power.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating a VGC team matchup to select three Pokémon and a safe lead against the opponent's lineup.

decisions.thought: Opponent Garchomp is faster, but Fake Out has +3 priority and flinches. This gives free damage and stops its attack this turn.

Incineroar is slower and Earthquake hits it super effectively, likely dealing huge damage even at -1 Attack. Setting rocks is fine but punishing the lead now while Garchomp has Sash protection is better value.

Incineroar will likely Fake Out again or pivot with Parting Shot; Earthquake hits it hard but it may just switch. Setting Stealth Rock now while Garchomp is slowed and sash is intact gives long-term value, and EQ damage is wasted if Incineroar pivots.
Opponent Garchomp outspeeds and threatens Earthquake, while Flare Blitz is resisted. Parting Shot further drops its Attack and pivots out safely.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Incineroar’s matchup and move options against Garchomp to choose between Parting Shot pivot and direct switch.

decisions.thought: Opponent Garchomp is at -2 Attack after Intimidate and Parting Shot, so it is crippled and likely to switch. Primarina resists Dragon and threatens Water/Fairy STAB.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing forced switch options to choose between Primarina and Garchomp against an opposing Garchomp.

decisions.thought: Moonblast is super effective on Garchomp and should knock out from 84% before it moves, since Primarina is slower but Garchomp is weakened.
Garchomp is at -2 Attack and Primarina resists nothing but can hit back hard with Moonblast; staying is a bad matchup. Gholdengo threatens Primarina hard with Make It Rain and is fresh. Switch out.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Primarina resists EQ? No—Water/Fairy is neutral to Ground. Garchomp at -2 Atk, EQ still decent damage. Primarina likely threatens with Moonblast. Garchomp is weakened attacker; switch to Gholdengo? Primarina may use Sparkling Aria—Gholdengo immune? No, Water hits. Gholdengo good matchup vs Primarina (resists nothing... Steel resists Water? No, neutral). Gholdengo threatens Primarina with Make It Rain. Switch to Gholdengo.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo outspeeds and Moonblast only does half due to Steel resisting Fairy, so it's safe. Make It Rain is neutral (Water resists, Fairy weak) and with Life Orb should chunk Primarina hard, possibly forcing it out or KOing it later. Nasty Plot is too passive while Primarina chips me down.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Primarina at 87% after SR. Make It Rain: Steel vs Water/Fairy is resisted (0.5x each? Steel is super vs Fairy, resisted by Water — Water resists Steel, Fairy weak to Steel → net 1x? Actually Water resists Steel (0.5), Fairy weak to Steel (2x) → 1x combined). Primarina SpD high though. Shadowball: Ghost vs Water/Fairy neutral... Fairy isn't immune to Ghost; neutral both → 1x. Make It Rain 120 BP with Life Orb vs Primarina's SpD ~150. Likely not KO. Primarina Moonblast vs Gholdengo: Fairy vs Steel/Ghost — Steel resists Fairy? No, Fairy is not resisted by Steel... Steel resists Fairy? Yes, Steel resists Fairy (0.5). Ghost neutral to Fairy. So Moonblast 0.5x on Gholdengo. Gholdengo took Moonblast for 50 HP (112/162 from 162). So Moonblast does ~50, Gholdengo survives comfortably.

Best play: Make It Rain to chunk Primarina, or Nasty Plot? Primarina likely slower; Gholdengo outspeeds. Make It Rain damage: 120 BP, Life Orb, SpA 185 vs SpD ~150, neutral. Roughly 55-70%? Primarina HP ~170. 252 SpA Life Orb Gholdengo Make It Rain vs 252 HP/0 SpD Primarina: ~ (120*1.3) ... estimate ~60-75%. Not guaranteed KO but big chunk. Primarina could be SpD invested. Make It Rain is fine; also drops own SpA but we can switch later.

Alternatively Nasty Plot since Moonblast only halves. But Primarina might have Sparkling Aria etc. Make It Rain pressure is good. Choose makeitrain.

decisions.thought: Primarina is slower than Gholdengo and weak to Steel, so staying in risks a knockout before Flip Turn. Hard switch to resist.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokémon type matchups and damage to choose the optimal pivot move and switch.

decisions.thought: Incineroar just switched in and hasn't used Fake Out yet, so it will almost certainly Fake Out to flinch me. Protect dodges that for free, keeps my Life Orb recoil off, and lets me keep momentum next turn.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Incineroar likely Parting Shot/Fake Out; Gholdengo immune to status via Good as Gold. Make It Rain hits Incineroar hard (resisted but 120 BP, -2 spa). Incineroar at 47%, likely KO? Resisted 120 BP with -2 spa... maybe not KO. Nasty Plot risky vs Fake Out? Fake Out flinch. Incineroar will likely Fake Out (flinch) — Gholdengo immune to status but not flinch. Protect? Fake Out only first turn back in... Incineroar came in turn 4, Fake Out already used? No, it used Fake Out earlier turn 2? Turn 2 was Parting Shot. Fake Out unused since switch-in, so likely Fake Out now. Protect avoids flinch and preserves momentum.

decisions.thought: Flare Blitz is super effective and should KO the weakened Gholdengo. Parting Shot and Taunt fail vs Good as Gold, and Fake Out can't hit Ghost.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating damage and speed matchup to choose the optimal move for Incineroar against Gholdengo.

decisions.thought: Incineroar is at 47% and my Gholdengo is at -2 SpA, so Make It Rain barely scratches it. Flare Blitz threatens to KO me, and Incineroar often Parting Shots after Fake Out turns. Protect scouts their move safely while keeping my weakened Gholdengo alive.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Incineroar at 47%, likely Flare Blitz again. Make It Rain resisted but with Life Orb and -2 SpA... it did 25%→22% earlier at 0 SpA. At -2 it's weak. Nasty Plot risks Flare Blitz hit (96/162, Flare Blitz ~40%+). Protect to scout? Incineroar likely Parting Shot soon. Nasty Plot risky. Protect is safe: they may Parting Shot, we keep momentum. But Protect then they switch... Actually Nasty Plot then next turn sweep? Flare Blitz would do big damage. Protect seems best.

decisions.thought: Flare Blitz is super effective and Gholdengo is at 59% with -1 Attack, so it should secure the knockout before weakened Make It Rain threatens. Parting Shot and Taunt are blocked by Good as Gold.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing damage and move priority for Incineroar vs Gholdengo, weighing KO chance against Protect and Good as Gold immunity.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo is dead, so I must switch. Incineroar likely Fake Outs or Parting Shots next turn; Garchomp takes huge damage from Flare Blitz, while Sylveon walls Fire moves well and can Wish later. Sylveon is the safer pivot.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Incineroar at 31%, likely Fake Out next. Sylveon resists nothing... Garchomp weak to Flare Blitz. Sylveon can take hits and Wish later; but Incineroar may Parting Shot. Sylveon is safer switch.

decisions.thought: Pixilate Hyper Voice at ~108 BP should finish the 31% Incineroar, even if it's faster. Sylveon takes little from anything Incineroar can do, so no need for Wish or switching.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Incineroar at 31%, Sylveon Hyper Voice (Pixilate ~108 BP fairy) likely KOs. Speed uncertain but damage kills regardless.

decisions.thought: Incineroar is low and weak to Fairy, so staying in risks a knockout. Primarina resists Fairy and threatens back.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Pokémon battle options and move mechanics to choose between Parting Shot and switching.

decisions.thought: Primarina is at 26% HP; Pixilate-boosted Hyper Voice should knock it out. Even if Primarina is faster, finishing it now removes a threat before it can Moonblast or heal.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Primarina at 26%, Hyper Voice likely KOs (Pixilate 108 BP vs 26% HP). Sylveon may be slower but KO is KO.

decisions.thought: Primarina at 26% will be knocked out by another Pixilate Hyper Voice, so I must switch out of this bad matchup. Incineroar would die to Stealth Rock chip, Garchomp survives better.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating damage calculations and speed matchup to choose between switching or using Flip Turn against Sylveon.Assessing stealth rock damage and HP thresholds for Incineroar and Garchomp against Sylveon's Hyper Voice.

decisions.thought: Both replacements are in Hyper Voice KO range, but Incineroar has priority Fake Out to stop Sylveon for a turn, preserving Primarina.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating type matchups and HP to choose between Incineroar and Primarina against Sylveon's Hyper Voice.Comparing damage calculations and utility to pick the less critical faint between Incineroar and Primarina.

decisions.thought: Incineroar is at 6% and will likely switch or use Parting Shot; Hyper Voice can't be blocked by Fake Out since it's priority. Attacking keeps pressure, but if it Parting Shots into Primarina, Yawn forces a switch. Simplest: Hyper Voice to chip it out or force the switch.
Incineroar at 13 HP will die to Hyper Voice, so staying in is lost. Parting Shot lowers Sylveon SpA and pivots to Primarina safely.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating legal moves and turn order constraints to choose the optimal switch and damage mitigation.

decisions.thought: Only Primarina remains at 26.7% against full HP Sylveon, so I must send it out and hope to move.
Primarina is at 14% and Hyper Voice already KO'd two mons; it's faster possibly, but even Moonblast won't KO Sylveon from full. Hyper Voice KOs Primarina now before it can act or heal.
Primarina is at 14% and will likely faint to Pixilate Hyper Voice, with no teammates left to switch to. Torrent plus Mystic Water makes Sparkling Aria the strongest hit.
